brand.name: Lumière Facial Studio & Spa
brand.audience: Women-focused premium beauty, skincare and wellness
policies: Lumière studios are women-focused; every branch follows the same Lumière standard (SOP) for services and pricing.
Please arrive 10 minutes before your appointment.
Free cancellation or rescheduling up to 4 hours before the appointment.
Prices are standard across all branches and exclude GST.
Medi-facials such as the Vampire Facial (PRP), Microneedling and Carbon Laser are performed only by our aesthetic physician after a consultation; they cannot be booked directly.
Tell us about pregnancy, allergies, active skin conditions, recent peels or retinoid use when booking, so the therapist can adjust or advise.
Payment at the studio by UPI, card or cash. Gift cards are available at every branch.
extra_information: Bridal clients: we recommend starting the Royal Bridal Glow programme 6 to 8 weeks before the wedding and avoiding new or intensive treatments in the final week.
Festive season (Karwa Chauth, Teej, Diwali) slots fill quickly; suggest booking at least a week ahead.
Add-ons such as LED light therapy, sheet masks and gold masks can be added at the studio; the therapist will confirm the price.

guest_profiles.name: Young women (18-25)
guest_profiles.note: Ask about skin goals and sensitivity before suggesting a treatment.

guest_profiles.name: Working professionals (25-40)
guest_profiles.note: Offer convenient slots (early evening, weekends) and treatments that fit their schedule.

guest_profiles.name: Brides-to-be
guest_profiles.note: Ask the wedding date first and plan a timeline; avoid new or intensive treatments in the final week.

guest_profiles.name: Mature women (40+)
guest_profiles.note: Ask about sensitivity, comfort and goals. Age alone never decides what is suitable.

guest_profiles.name: New brides and honeymooners
guest_profiles.note: Ask the travel date and plan treatments a few days before travel.

guest_profiles.name: Luxury self-care
guest_profiles.note: Lead with the most indulgent experiences and suggest combinations.
